mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for FEDFUNDS predicting 20-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when UNRATE rises >0.3pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and high consumer spending (RSAFS > 360,000 million dollars) indicate robust economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% and RSAFS > 360,000.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising), higher interest rates compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances during monetary tightening cycles.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST) reflect robust consumer demand and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window for HOUST predicting 5-day SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 indicates weakening manufacturing and services activity, triggering economic contraction fears and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: Rapid inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%) combined with low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 5.0%) signals impending monetary tightening, pressuring equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market regime (UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 135,000 thousand persons), strong employment conditions drive consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS > 135,000.
